headings.text: An independent bank built on trust, clarity and patience
For more than two decades, Vaxmor has helped households, founders and businesses bank, invest and plan with confidence, guided by one advisor and fees you can see in full.

images.alt: Senior team gathered around a meeting table reviewing documents

paragraphs: What began as a small advisory office in London now serves 12,000 clients, run on the same promise: clear advice, fair fees, one advisor.
What began as a small advisory office in London now serves 12,000 clients, run on the same promise: clear advice, fair fees, one advisor.
Céline Hart opened our first office in 2001 with six clients and one rule: explain every fee before it is charged. That rule still shapes how every advisor works today.
